scope: README/config/serve/environment instructions accuracy, checksum install safety, PATH/service guidance and migration traps (README.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/ENVIRONMENT.md, docs/SERVE.md, .env.example, package.json scripts, scripts/package.ts, src/settings/*, src/cli*, src/config.ts, src/main.ts, src/serve-command.ts, src/store.ts)

findings.title: Quickstart tells the operator to create .env, but no supported entry point loads it
findings.evidence: README.md:9 instructs `cp .env.example .env` and fill six values, then README.md:12 shows plain `bun run dev` and README.md:26 says production starts with `bun start`. package.json:10-13 makes every script `bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null src/cli.ts ...` and scripts/package.ts:106 sets autoload_dotenv:false for the compiled binary, so Bun never loads .env. src/main.ts:7 calls resolveServerSettings() with no options, so only a config file (src/settings/paths.ts:58), its env_file, an explicit --env-file, or the process environment is read (src/settings/load.ts:738-762). The corrected form appears only later, at README.md:17-22.
findings.reproduction: Reproduced with Bun 1.4.2 in a /tmp copy of the target. With a filled .env in the checkout cwd: `bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null src/cli.ts serve --check-config` exits 1 with 'Invalid configuration: FREESTYLE_API_TOKEN ... SWARMFORGE_GIT_TREE: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined'. Adding `--env-file .env` exits 0 with ok:true. Consequence: the documented first-run and production commands cannot start the server. tests/packaging.test.ts:851 only asserts the scripts contain --no-env-file and :871 tests the corrected --env-file form; no test parses README.md:9 or :12.
findings.recommendation: Change README.md:9 and README.md:26 to `bun run start -- --env-file .env` (or exported values), and correct docs/ENVIRONMENT.md:3 ('Bun loads `.env`'), which is false for every supported entry point.

findings.title: docs/ENVIRONMENT.md still publishes the replaced SWARMFORGE_DB_PATH default; silent new-database cutover
findings.evidence: ENVIRONMENT.md:31 documents the default as `./data/swarmforge.sqlite`. src/settings/load.ts:835-841 sets the key to defaultDatabasePath() (src/settings/paths.ts:66-72) = $XDG_DATA_HOME/swarmforge/... when absolute, else ~/.local/share/swarmforge/swarmforge.sqlite. The old value survives only as loadConfig's zod default (src/config.ts:77), which the resolver always overrides. CONFIGURATION.md:130-131 states the XDG default 'replaces the environment-only default ./data/swarmforge.sqlite', and CONFIGURATION.md:3 claims ENVIRONMENT.md 'stays valid', yet this branch did not update ENVIRONMENT.md (diff vs base 5672ead touches README, CONFIGURATION.md, SERVE.md, package.json, scripts only).
findings.reproduction: Reproduced: with no SWARMFORGE_DB_PATH set and an isolated HOME, `bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null src/cli.ts config show` exits 0 and reports SWARMFORGE_DB_PATH=<HOME>/.local/share/swarmforge/swarmforge.sqlite with source 'default'. Consequence for an existing deployment that relied on the documented default: the server silently opens a new empty database, all worker rows/results/instance history disappear, and nothing refuses the cutover because the instance-ID ownership check (startup step 3 in docs/SERVE.md) passes against the new empty file. tests/settings.test.ts:169-184 asserts the new default, so code and tests agree and only the doc cell is stale.
findings.recommendation: Update the ENVIRONMENT.md:31 default cell to the XDG value with its ~ / absolute note, and add a short migration warning there; optionally add a test asserting documented defaults match the resolver.

findings.title: Documented systemd unit omits WorkingDirectory while the shipped db_path is relative
findings.evidence: The unit at README.md:95-101 sets only Type/ExecStart/TimeoutStopSec/Restart - no WorkingDirectory - and passes only --env-file. .env.example:36 ships `SWARMFORGE_DB_PATH=./data/swarmforge.sqlite`, a relative path. src/settings/load.ts:796-804 anchors an env-file host_path at prepared.cwd (the invocation directory, docs/CONFIGURATION.md:132-134), and src/store.ts:19 does mkdirSync(dirname(path), {recursive:true}) before opening SQLite. systemd's default working directory is `/`.
findings.reproduction: Anchoring reproduced: `serve --check-config --env-file ./secrets.env` run from an empty directory exits 0 and resolves SWARMFORGE_DB_PATH=<cwd>/data/swarmforge.sqlite. The systemd cwd=/ case is code-evidenced, not executed. Consequence: the database lands at /data/swarmforge.sqlite (created as root), silently splitting the deployment, or startup fails with EACCES for a non-root User= and exits 1 (src/serve-command.ts:175-180). src/cli.ts:194-201 (--check-config) can report the anchored path but the README never tells the operator to run it for the unit; tests/settings.test.ts:391-404 pins the anchoring as intended.
findings.recommendation: Add WorkingDirectory= (and User=) to the README unit, and note beside .env.example:36 that the relative default resolves against the process working directory so services should set an absolute path.

findings.title: ENVIRONMENT.md still asserts 'Bun loads .env'
findings.evidence: ENVIRONMENT.md:3 opens with 'Bun loads `.env`', contradicted by README.md:17, README.md:67-68 ('it does not read .env, bunfig.toml, tsconfig.json or package.json') and scripts/package.ts:106-111 (autoload_dotenv:false).
findings.reproduction: Code-evidenced by the delta diff: package.json:10-13 adds --no-env-file to dev/start/status/serve in this branch while ENVIRONMENT.md is unchanged from base 5672ead. Consequence: an operator debugging a configuration that is silently not read.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the sentence to name --env-file, config env_file and SWARMFORGE_CONFIG as the only ways a file is read.

tests.command: Bun 1.4.2 at /tmp/opencode/bun142/bun-linux-x64/bun (host Bun 1.3.14 cannot read this lockfile; lockfile never rewritten). `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in /tmp/opencode/rv/probe copy: exit 0, 125 packages, git status clean. `bun test tests/settings.test.ts`: exit 0, 56 pass / 0 fail, 404 assertions. `bun test tests/cli.test.ts`: exit 0, 2 pass / 0 fail, 10 assertions. Probes: `config show` with no SWARMFORGE_DB_PATH and isolated HOME -> exit 0, reports ~/.local/share/swarmforge/swarmforge.sqlite, source default. `serve --check-config` with .env present but not passed -> exit 1, six required values reported missing. `serve --check-config --env-file .env` -> exit 0, ok true, db_path anchored to cwd. `serve --check-config --env-file ./secrets.env` in an empty dir -> exit 0, <cwd>/data/swarmforge.sqlite, no files created. README install block executed verbatim on a synthetic archive built the way scripts/package.ts builds one: good archive -> exit 0, 'swarmforge: OK', installed mode 0755; repacked archive with edited payload -> exit 1, 'swarmforge: FAILED' + checksum warning, nothing installed. Not run: full suite (whole-suite reviewer's scope), packaging/compile tests, any cloud/provider/VM smoke.
tests.summary: 2 targeted test files passed (58 assertions-suites: 56+2 pass, 0 fail) and 7 bounded local probes; every exit code above was captured. All probe inputs are placeholders in isolated /tmp directories; no provider or remote was contacted.

limitations: Finding 3's systemd consequence is inferred from the documented unit plus reproduced relative-path anchoring and src/store.ts mkdirSync; no unit file was loaded into systemd.

Only README.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/ENVIRONMENT.md, docs/SERVE.md and .env.example were audited; docs/MCP-API.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, OBSERVABILITY.md, WORKER-PROTOCOL.md, RESEARCH.md and IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md were not reviewed.
`swarmforge status` against a live MCP endpoint, TLS/reverse-proxy guidance and the Git-handoff setup steps were reviewed by reading only.
